title: Financial Officer 2.1: proposed new baseline
banner: PROPOSED NEW BASELINE. NOT A RECOVERED ORIGINAL. NOT FROZEN. NOT ADOPTED.

The original canonical document for this persona was not recovered. This document is a new design prepared from recovered evidence, existing frozen persona contracts and the executable authority contracts, for product specification review.

It grants no authority. Every institutional authority decision it names is outstanding. Engineering implementation and synthetic authorized-path testing are permitted. Production or institutional activation of the authority a decision governs is prohibited until a duly authorized body adopts the decision.

labels.HISTORICALLY_EVIDENCED: The identifier is individually evidenced by a recovered historical record. Only the identifier and the recorded title or status are historical; the specification is new.
labels.PROPOSED_NEW_BASELINE: The specification is a new design in this proposed baseline. Every contract carries this label.
labels.IMPLEMENTED_SOURCE: The cited source files show some implementation. A cited file is not verification, conformance was not checked, and no run exists.
labels.REQUIRES_INSTITUTIONAL_ADOPTION: The behaviour depends on an institutional authority decision that is outstanding. It stays inactive until a duly authorized body adopts it.

CASE_OWNER_OR_ASSIGNEE.definition: A live owner or assignee relationship to this one case, held by a principal whose live membership carries a representation capacity (steward, chief steward or officer). The relationship is a fact about the case; the capacity is eligibility only. Closing, disclosing to the member and exporting sealed evidence are additionally limited to the primary handler.

CASE_PRIMARY_HANDLER_ONLY.definition: The owner or assignee relationship, limited to the primary handler. A collaborator grant can never carry these actions.

CASE_COLLABORATOR_EXPLICIT.definition: A live collaborator relationship that was granted explicitly by someone other than its holder, names each permission, carries an expiry, and never reaches privileged matters unless a separate independent privileged grant exists.

CASE_MEMBER_OWN.definition: The represented member or creator of this case, as a live derived relationship. It reaches only the member-visible view of the case.

CASE_SUPERVISORY_MANDATE.definition: A live supervisory mandate whose unit, territory or resource scope covers this case and whose powers name the action. Seniority, role title and platform status are not inputs. Privileged matters are outside every mandate except assignment.

CASE_TRIAGE_DESIGNATION.definition: A live, expiring, revocable triage designation for the cases scope, granted by an organization administrator to an eligible staff member for at most 90 days. It exposes the unassigned queue metadata only and grants no kernel action on any case.

CASE_FILING_CAPACITY.definition: An active canonical membership whose capacity allows opening a matter in the stated mode (member, handler or bulk). Opening a matter grants no access to anyone else’s case.

CASE_EMERGENCY_GRANT.definition: A live, justified, independently approved, time-boxed, read-only emergency grant that names this case. It never reaches privileged matters.

THREAD_PARTICIPANT.definition: The member of the conversation, or its assignee when that membership carries an assignee capacity. Participation follows the conversation row; no mandate and no delegation confers it.

THREAD_TRIAGE_DESIGNATION.definition: A live triage designation for the messages scope. It exposes the unassigned conversation queue only and is not a read of any conversation.

GOVERNANCE_MANDATE_THREAD_HOLD.definition: A live governance review mandate whose powers name the action and whose scope names the conversation or the organization retention record. It confers no read of the conversation and cannot be delegated.

DOCUMENT_CASE_RELATIONSHIP_AND_CLASS.definition: A kernel decision on the linked case together with the document classification. A privileged classification needs an explicit independent privileged-access grant; a role never reaches it.

DIRECTORY_SCOPE_BY_CASE_RELATIONSHIP.definition: The member directory policy: a steward sees self and the members of cases assigned to them; supervisory and officer scopes widen the directory without sensitive attributes only through the stated policy; only platform administrators cross organizations.

WORKAID_REFERRAL_WITH_CONSENT.definition: The case relationship that permits a referral, plus a live member disclosure consent whose categories, purpose, recipient and expiry cover what moves. A union-authored record can never open counsel material. Consent wording is an institutional instrument that this baseline does not write.

ORG_ADMIN_OPERATIONS.definition: Administration of the tenant. The organization administrator title carries no case, money or governance capacity; it may grant a time-boxed triage designation and perform tenant operations only.

REPRESENTATION_PROTOCOL_APPROVAL.definition: A representation protocol approved by an administrator who is not its author. An unapproved, missing or invalid protocol is not executable and fails closed.

SELF_SCOPED.definition: The signed-in principal’s own preferences and session. No other principal’s resource is touched.

ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP_NAVIGATION.definition: A live membership in the active organization. A navigation entry is only an entry point: every resource behind it is decided individually, and an entry is not shown when its destination would resolve to an unavailable state.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_VIEW.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the view duty, held by a principal with a financial capacity. A member may always view their own record. A role title, including the Secretary-Treasurer title, is not a mandate.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_PREPARE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the prepare duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-01 stops a preparer approving the same transaction; whether an institution adopts that separation is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_APPROVE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the approve duty, within its monetary limit and currency. The implemented software rules SEP-SW-01 and SEP-SW-02 refuse an approver who prepared the same transaction or who later executes it. An adverse party is refused. Institutional adoption of the separation is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_EXECUTE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the execute duty. Execution is the money movement itself and happens only in the route that moves the money. The implemented software rules SEP-SW-02 and SEP-SW-03 refuse an executor who prepared or approved the same transaction, and a reconciler who took part in it. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_RECONCILE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the reconcile duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-03 refuses a reconciler who took part in the same transaction. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_AUDIT.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the audit duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-04 refuses an auditor who took part in the same transaction. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_SUBJECT_OWN_RECORD.definition: The member viewing their own financial record, and nothing else’s.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_ADMINISTRATION.definition: Issuance, acceptance, suspension and revocation of a financial mandate under a live issuance rule. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-07 requires the issuer, the holder and the approver to be three different people, and SEP-SW-08 stops the issuer and approver activating the mandate; that is evidence of a software rule and not proof that an institution adopted it. The holder activates; an expired term is not activated. No mandate is issued from a request body or derived from a role title.

TRUSTEE_APPOINTMENT_DUTY.definition: The trustee capacity, which is earned only by a recorded appointment and never by role, together with a live mandate naming the duty.

AUDITOR_APPOINTMENT_DUTY.definition: The auditor capacity, which is earned only by a recorded appointment and never by role, together with a live mandate naming the audit duty and the period.

UNDECIDED_INSTITUTIONAL_OFFICE.definition: No source of authority is defined for this action. The institution must name the office, the mandate or the rule that holds it. Until then the action is not offered, and a role floor in the current source is not treated as that authority.

ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ONLY.definition: A role, capacity, title or seniority makes a person eligible to hold an authority. It never is the authority. A denial contract names what a role never grants.

PLATFORM_BOUNDARY_NO_AUTHORITY.definition: Nzila platform billing is not union finance. Platform staff status and SaaS entitlement confer no authority over union financial records.

authorityStatesVocabulary.rule: An outstanding institutional authority decision does not stop engineering. It stops production or institutional activation of the authority the decision governs.

states.ENGINEERING_IMPLEMENTATION: PERMITTED. Drafts, queues, previews, read models, refusal paths and positive paths may be built.
states.SYNTHETIC_AUTHORIZED_PATH_TESTING: PERMITTED. A positive path may be demonstrated with test-issued authority in a synthetic organization that is marked synthetic and holds no real member, money or privileged record.
states.PRODUCTION_INSTITUTIONAL_ACTIVATION: PROHIBITED until a duly authorized body adopts the decision. No real organization receives the authority.
states.EXTERNAL_OR_INSTITUTIONAL_ADOPTION: REQUIRED. The decision is settled outside this repository and is recorded here only as outstanding.

syntheticAuthority.note: Test-issued authority exists only inside a test fixture. It is never copied into, derived from or promoted to a real organization.

prohibitedWithoutInstitutionalAdoption.prohibited: Issuing a real financial mandate. FINANCIAL_MANDATES_NOT_ISSUED stays the answer.
Establishing, naming or filling an institutional office, including a steward office.
Authorizing or executing a real payment, payment rail or export to an external accounting system.
Disclosing privileged, counsel-controlled or third-party restricted material to anyone.
Activating counsel execution or transmitting anything to counsel. UE-CONV-G-003 stays an external gate.

contracts.title: Financial mandate register

historical.note: Status only. The record gives no label for this identifier.

contracts.proposedMeaning: The register of financial mandates: who holds which duty on which account, within what limit and until when. It supports issuing, accepting, suspending and revoking a mandate. No mandate exists until a successful issue.
contracts.actor: The issuer, the holder and the approver of a mandate
contracts.trigger: An authorized issuer opens a mandate for issue, or a holder accepts or a party revokes it.
contracts.resource: One financial mandate and its parties, powers, account, limit, currency and term.
preconditions: A live issuance rule adopted by the institution.
Where the implemented rule SEP-SW-07 applies, as it does in source today, the issuer, holder and approver are three different people. An institution has not adopted it as a requirement (DEC-IA-16).
The term is not expired.
contracts.permittedAction: Issue, activate (by the holder), suspend or revoke a mandate.
contracts.persistedResult: One mandate row or one status change with the three parties and time.

authorization.requirement: A live issuance rule (DEC-IA-16). The holder activates. No mandate is issued from a request body or derived from a role title.
authorization.recusal: Where an implemented software rule or an institutionally adopted separation rule prohibits a duty combination on this transaction, account or record, a principal who already holds one of the pair cannot take the other. No rule is assumed beyond those listed in the separation model. A live recusal or adverse-party status on the transaction or record denies every duty. Lifting a recusal is an institutional decision (DEC-IA-07).

audit.note: The persisted result and its audit record commit together; a failed audit record rolls the result back.

privacy.note: Individual member financial data is visible only to the member and to a live mandate that names the account. Unknown values stay unknown and are never shown as zero or paid up.

contracts.userVisibleOutcome: The register lists each mandate with its status. With none issued it says that no financial mandate has been issued.

denialAndRecovery.behavior: Without an adopted issuance rule nothing is issued. The capability answers HTTP 501 with an honest not-available state. It never returns a success it did not perform.

implementation.note: The lifecycle service issues, activates and revokes. No route or page exposes it and no issuance rule is adopted.

provenance.design: The meaning is a new design choice. It is not historically evidenced.

financial.operationalCapability: The register is the only way a financial duty comes to exist.

requiredSegregationOfDuties.summary: Mandate issuance is evaluated by SEP-SW-07 and SEP-SW-08, which are implemented software rules. A governed exception for a small local is a proposal (SEP-PI-04).

financial.dataAndReportingScope: Mandate records for the organization. No transaction data.

reasons: Separation is evaluated by rules against the actual transaction, account, amount, mandate, approval and principal. It is not a universal different-person requirement.

segregationModel.rule: Viewing, preparing, approving, executing, reconciling and auditing stay separate powers. Whether one principal may hold two of them is decided by a separation rule evaluated against the actual transaction, account, amount, mandate, approval and principal. segregationModel.threePersonIssuance: The three-person issuance design (SEP-SW-07) is evidence of an implemented software rule. It is not proof that an institution adopted it.

technicalProtections.meaning: A transaction whose recorded approvals contradict each other is refused and nothing proceeds on it.

source.quote: recorded approvals violate segregation of duties

technicalProtections.title: The amount and currency must match the record
technicalProtections.meaning: A request that differs from the amount or currency on record is refused, so one figure cannot be approved and another executed.

source.quote: requested amount differs from the amount on record

technicalProtections.title: The transaction state must allow the duty
technicalProtections.meaning: A duty is refused when the transaction is not in a state that allows it, and execution is refused until the required approvals are met.

technicalProtections.title: An adverse party or recused principal is refused
technicalProtections.meaning: A live recusal or adverse-party status denies the duty before any source of authority is consulted.

technicalProtections.title: A financial duty is not delegable
technicalProtections.meaning: The source refuses a delegation on every finance action. Whether any duty may be delegated is an outstanding institutional decision (DEC-IA-17); the refusal is a technical default until then.

separationRules.title: The preparer does not approve their own transaction
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the transaction’s recorded preparer.

source.quote: the preparer cannot approve their own transaction

separationRules.title: The executor is independent of the preparer and approvers
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the transaction’s recorded preparer and approvers.

source.quote: the executor must be independent of the preparer and approvers

separationRules.title: The reconciler is independent of the transaction’s participants
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the preparer, approvers and executor.

source.quote: the reconciler must be independent of the preparer, approvers and executor

separationRules.title: The auditor is independent of the transaction audited
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against every participant of the transaction.

source.quote: an auditor must be independent of the transaction they audit

separationRules.title: An approver approves a transaction once
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the approvals already recorded. It is separate from the number of approvals a class of transaction needs.

separationRules.title: Incompatible duties are not held together over one account
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated when a mandate is issued, against the duties one principal holds on the same account. The pairs are read from source and are not every pair of duties.
separationRules.derivedFrom: INCOMPATIBLE_DUTIES in the finance policy source

separationRules.title: A mandate has three different issuer, holder and approver
separationRules.meaning: Evidence of an implemented software rule at issuance. It is not proof that any institution adopted it, and a small local may not have three people.

source.quote: The issuer, the holder and the approver of a financial mandate are three different people.

separationRules.title: The issuer and approver do not activate the mandate
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the mandate’s recorded parties.

source.quote: The issuer and the approver do not activate the mandate they created.

separationRules.title: Independent approvals required per class of transaction
separationRules.meaning: The number of independent approvals a class of transaction needs, by amount, account and mandate. Source records a required-approvals count on a transaction; the policy that sets it is outstanding.

separationRules.title: A recipient does not approve a payment to themselves
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the beneficiary of the payment, such as a stipend recipient or an expense claimant.

separationRules.title: A vendor bank change is not approved by the person who made it
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the vendor record and the principal who changed its banking reference.

separationRules.title: A governed exception for a small local
separationRules.meaning: Where an institution cannot meet a rule, an exception names the rule relaxed, the compensating control and the independent reviewer. No exception exists unless the institution adopts one.

separationRules.title: The exporter did not approve the records exported
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the approvers of the exported records.

separationRules.title: The preparer of a tax slip does not issue it
Maker-checker on one non-transaction record
separationRules.meaning: The preparer and approver of one account change, billing cycle, budget version, vendor record, plan or fund movement. Source evaluates this for payment transactions, not for these records.

separationRules.title: A person affected by an action does not take part in it
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the principal an action revokes, suspends or otherwise affects.

separationRules.title: The preparer of a record does not reconcile it
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against the remittance or record the principal prepared.

separationRules.title: An auditor takes no part in the records audited
separationRules.meaning: Evaluated against every duty the auditor holds on the audited records.

reportingModel.rule: A report, an aggregate and an export are each authorized on their own. A view duty over the records behind a report does not carry them.

authorizationDimensions.requires: Each class of field is granted: member-identifying, contact, banking and amount fields are separate grants.
An aggregate over a population is a separate grant from the rows beneath it. A small population can identify an individual, so a minimum-population rule and suppression are decided per report.
The accounts, periods, locals and bargaining units the report covers are named by the mandate.
Each report carries a sensitivity class. Member personal data, audit-restricted data and privileged data are never in a general report.
An export is a separate duty-checked action with its own record naming requester, scope, fields, destination and time. An external accounting target needs DEC-IA-29.
Two permitted reports must not combine to disclose what neither may disclose. Comparison and differencing risk is reviewed per report.

platformBillingBoundary.rule: Nzila platform billing and Union Eyes institutional finance are separate. A page, route or service that belongs to platform economics is never evidence of a union finance capability, and no union finance destination is built from one.

evidence.quote: Unified export point for all 5 DAPL layers
Canonical append-only ledger for all platform economics entries

navigationAdvertisement.NOT_ADVERTISED_UNTIL_IMPLEMENTED: Every capability behind the destination is NOT_IMPLEMENTED or answers HTTP 501. The entry is not shown.
navigationAdvertisement.SHOWN_WITH_STATE_LABELS: Some capability behind the destination is partly implemented. The entry is shown, and each unavailable capability is labelled with its state. A page existing is not evidence of an operational engine.
navigationAdvertisement.SHOWN_WHEN_USABLE: Every capability behind the destination is implemented. The entry is shown only to a principal who can use it.
